title: Christmas LoFi with Mishka
scene: Christmas Eve in a cozy wooden cabin at night. Mishka lies on a patchwork quilt in the center-right, gazing toward a large wooden window on the right where heavy snow falls over pine trees and small houses with lit windows under a deep blue sky. On the left, a Christmas tree with warm string lights and ornaments, wrapped gifts beneath it. A stone fireplace with a glowing fire in the background. Next to Mishka, a small table with a steaming mug of cocoa, a tiny open music box and a vintage record player. A fabric lamp with amber light, hanging plants and books. Quiet, intimate, nostalgic.
